title: Keep returning until remembrance holds you
summary: The shabad is repetitive on purpose. Peace is cultivated by returning again.
takeaway: Remembrance is a rhythm, not a one-time correction.
lifeApplication: Choose one short simran phrase and return to it instead of feeding the same anxious loop.

source.shortMeaning: Peace comes through repeated remembrance, not through endless mental churn.
source.lifeApplication: Interrupt worry with repetition that re-roots the heart.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace comes through repeated remembrance, not through endless mental churn.
evidence.turn: Steady remembrance calms what scattered thinking cannot.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one short simran phrase and return to it instead of feeding the same anxious loop.
